# vendor

`vendor.ttklia.com/{outlet}`: the POS till (`/{outlet}/pos`, full screen on the `counter` layer) and the vendor
back office (Fleet Management skeleton). Docs: 09, 27, 32; routes: Sitemap 6.

```bash
cd ../..            # ttklia-web
npm run dev:vendor  # then open http://localhost:3000/<outlet>
```
